designationHistory.indexText: Established April 22, 1994, under the Endangered Species Act to protect the rare scrub plants and animals of central Florida's Lake Wales Ridge.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Lake Wales Ridge National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
FWS ServCat: Lake Wales Ridge NWR CCP: approved Feb. 15, 1994; established April 22, 1994

review.note: FWS page says 1993 (the final EA and land protection plan date, Nov. 1993). The CCP says the refuge was approved Feb. 15, 1994, and established April 22, 1994.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Lake Wales Ridge National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1993 as the first refuge designated for the recovery of endangered and threatened plants.
